bullets.text: Immersive Productivity Unleashed - **Windows 11** and **Meta Quest** now integrate for enhanced mixed reality productivity.
Edge for Business Security Boost - New connectors enhance **Microsoft Edge** security, integrating with existing tools for better protection.
AI Security Threats Revealed - New e-book outlines critical generative AI threats and strategies for organizations to enhance security.
AI Evaluation Made Easy - **Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation** libraries help developers ensure AI applications deliver reliable results.
Copilot's New Text Features - **Windows Insiders** can now interact with **Copilot** using text input for enhanced user experience.
AI-First Differentiation Strategy - **Microsoft** empowers customers to leverage AI for operational excellence and innovation.
Strengthening OpenAI Partnership - **Microsoft** and **OpenAI** sign new agreement to enhance collaboration and innovation in AI.
